notes.title: Small update and biggest sale yet!
notes.content:
Hi!

We have just updated Painting Werther. 
We also have started development in our next game. More announcements to come.

The update consists in a lot of small bug fixes and other small details.

We are also having our biggest sale yet! 
Have fun and thank you for your many reviews of our game. 
We are really thankful to all of you.
